common_context: Keep original ModuleA/PDFp2 finger formulas visible as suggestions; the source permits adaptation of open-string forms. No new fixed finger assignment.
Major roots first, minor roots second, then randomize quality and inversion (PDFpp3–6). This policy selects one shape and does not implement a workout sequencer.

SEVEN ROOTS x TWO QUALITIES x THREE INVERSIONS
Each cell lists the three frets from the lowest string of the set to the highest. Form silently, play one blocked attack, then arpeggiate low-middle-high. Release completely before the next shape.
MUTING Only A-D-G may sound; mute every other string with the fretting hand or picking-hand edge.

setup: For the broader workbook session, choose one string set, one root family, and one progression (PDFp1). After a set-transfer exercise, relax the hand fully before repeating its cycle (PDFp1). This one-cell Module B guide supplies only the selected shape: progression selection/execution and set-transfer sequencing remain broader-session context outside the guide. It neither generates nor marks those tasks complete, and starting this scoped guide does not require a new progression realization.
Look-name-form-release the triad silently before its first attack (PDFp1); name the bass as root, third or fifth.
Form the selected shape silently (PDFpp3–6); use minimum pressure.
Mute every string outside the chosen three-string set using fretting hand or picking-hand edge.
